title: Reconstruct data dtype on masked return path in algorithms.mode
answers: Why does Series.mode(dropna=False) raise TypeError for boolean dtype?
How to fix Series.mode raising TypeError with dropna=False on nullable boolean Series?
Why does mode in pandas.core.algorithms return raw numeric values for masked boolean data?
body:
Symptom: Series.mode(dropna=False) raises TypeError on nullable boolean Series.
Root cause: pandas/core/algorithms.py:mode returned raw numerical counting results on the masked return path without calling pandas/core/algorithms.py:_reconstruct_data to restore the original dtype.
Fix pattern: Call _reconstruct_data(npresult, original.dtype, original) on masked return paths before returning results with res_mask.
Constraints: Applies to mode() when res_mask is not None for nullable or extension dtypes; unmasked paths already reconstruct data downstream.
applies: pandas/core/algorithms.py:mode when calculating mode with dropna=False on nullable or extension array dtypes
